description: This file defines a React component for an 'Add Reminder' dialog in the Notesnook application, including UI elements for setting reminder details such as date, time, recurrence, priority, and description. It also registers the dialog with a dialog manager and provides an 'Edit Reminder' wrapper.

classes.name: AddReminderDialog
classes.description: A React component registered as a dialog for adding or editing reminders, with internal state management for reminder properties.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to display the 'Edit Reminder' dialog for a specific reminder ID.
